items.name: styles
items.title: Caliper UI tokens and base styles
items.description: Colour, radius, motion and density tokens, the Tailwind adapter and a small base stylesheet. Every part needs them; import them once in your global CSS. Each part brings its own stylesheet.

items.name: about-template
items.title: About template
items.description: Who is behind the product, in the order buyers and candidates check: the belief, how you got here, the numbers, how you work, the people and the next step.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each reveal their content, one open at a time.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action button
items.description: A button that runs async work and reports progress, success or failure on itself, at one width.

items.name: action-swap
items.title: Action swap
items.description: A button that cycles through a few labelled states, swapping label and icon in place.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: A year of daily activity as a grid, with selection, and a footer that opens a ranked breakdown of where the activity went over the grid.

items.name: adaptive-stepper
items.title: Adaptive stepper
items.description: A quantity control that is a button at zero and a stepper above it.

items.name: agent-activity
items.title: Agent activity
items.description: A live line of what an agent is doing now, with a loading state.

items.name: agent-status
items.title: Agent status
items.description: One line inside a reply that says what the agent is doing right now, thinking, searching, reading or writing, with what it is working on and a running clock, then settles into how long it took.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message that keeps context and recovery beside the work.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: The Dialog surface for a decision that cannot be undone: no close button, no outside dismiss, focus starting on the safe choice.

items.name: animated-counter
items.title: Animated counter
items.description: A number that counts to its value, with prefix, suffix and locale.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated list
items.description: A list whose rows come and go gracefully: new rows open into place, removed rows close their gap and the rest glide to their new positions.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated tabs
items.description: Tabs with an expanding or morphing indicator, including closable tabs.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A thin bar for product news that rotates messages and remembers dismissal.

items.name: approvals
items.title: Approvals
items.description: Cards that ask the user to allow or deny an action, with a risk label.

items.name: arc-picker
items.title: Arc picker
items.description: Choose a value by moving along an arc.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that keeps a fixed ratio so images and video never shift the layout.

items.name: assistant-panel
items.title: Assistant panel
items.description: A docked panel that holds a conversation beside the product.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or image chip for chat inputs and forms, with an upload fill, a failed state with Retry and a card for images.

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Auth page
items.description: A centred sign-in or sign-up page with a brand header and legal links.

items.name: auto-height
items.title: Auto height
items.description: A container that follows its content's height, so a wizard step, a validation summary or a details panel grows and shrinks instead of snapping. The content changes at once.

items.name: availability-scheduler
items.title: Availability scheduler
items.description: Pick a day and a time slot from a host's availability.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo, falling back to initials when there is no image.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: A compact stack of avatars with an overflow count and presence.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, category or count.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A compact bar series with an accessible label.

items.name: billing-toggle
items.title: Billing toggle
items.description: A monthly/yearly switch whose price animates as it changes.

items.name: blog-grid
items.title: Blog grid
items.description: A grid of article cards with date, tag and summary.

items.name: blog-post-template
items.title: Blog post template
items.description: One article at a reading measure: a progress line under the header, an outline that marks where you are, linkable headings, the author and three related posts.

items.name: bloom-menu
items.title: Bloom menu
items.description: A button that blooms into a small arc of icon actions.

items.name: blur-image
items.title: Blur image
items.description: An image that sharpens into place over a blurred placeholder at its final size, and shows its description if it fails.

items.name: book-shelf
items.title: Book shelf
items.description: A shelf of documents as spines. Width follows the page count, so a dozen fit in a row and scan like a list. Hover or focus leans a spine out; choosing one pulls it off the shelf and opens its cover and details beside it.

items.name: booklet
items.title: Booklet
items.description: A short ordered read, turned page by page: release highlights, a tour, a report. Turning a page moves it from the pile you have not read to the pile you have, so the piles show how far through you are while the counter tells you exactly.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: A sheet that rises from the bottom with drag detents.

items.name: box-plot
items.title: Box plot
items.description: Distributions side by side as five-number summaries with outliers. Switching to every value spreads the points out from the median on the same axis.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current page, with each parent linked.

items.name: brush-chart
items.title: Brush chart
items.description: A chart you zoom by dragging a brush, with event annotations.

items.name: bullet-chart
items.title: Bullet chart
items.description: A KPI against its target in one line: the measure fills across poor, fair and good bands toward a target tick, with the gap written out.

items.name: bump-chart
items.title: Bump chart
items.description: Rank changes of several series across periods.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button, part of the Button family.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: A toolbar of related tools in one raised shell; toggled tools sink into it.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for choosing a day or a range, usable on its own or inside a picker.

items.name: call-to-action
items.title: Call to action
items.description: A closing band with one clear action.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A titled container with media, status, meta and optional expandable details.

items.name: card-folder
items.title: Card folder
items.description: A stack of cards in a folder tab.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card stack
items.description: A pile of cards you flick through one by one.

items.name: card-switcher
items.title: Card switcher
items.description: An app switcher for open pages. Cards fan out in depth by recency: the page you are on is in front and each step back is one page older. Flick a card up to close it, press the front card to open it full size.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable row of slides with controls and dots.

items.name: celebration-burst
items.title: Celebration burst
items.description: One small burst of confetti when a real milestone completes: the first deploy, a finished setup, a paid invoice. Skipped under reduced motion; the words say what happened.

items.name: changelog-feed
items.title: Changelog feed
items.description: Versioned release notes with typed changes.

items.name: changelog-template
items.title: Changelog template
items.description: What shipped, newest first: dates that stay in view, linkable versions, tag filters with a count and a product view per release.

items.name: character-ring
items.title: Character ring
items.description: Room left as a ring that fills as you type, turns amber near the limit with a countdown, and red with the overflow.

items.name: chart-story-block
items.title: Chart story block
items.description: A number told as a story: the chart draws in once, then each beat moves a marker to its moment and explains it. Readers step through; nothing advances on its own.

items.name: chat-shell
items.title: Chat shell
items.description: The frame of a chat screen: sidebar of chats, header, transcript and composer.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat thread
items.description: A thread of chat messages grouped by sender and time.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox with a clear checked, unchecked and indeterminate state.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: A list people tick through: a ticked item is struck out where it is, then settles into Done at the bottom, so what is left stays at the top. Add from the last row, reorder with Alt+arrows, undo from the line that confirms it.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip group
items.description: A set of toggleable chips for single or multiple choices.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Numbered source references and a list of the sources behind an answer.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Syntax-highlighted code with a language label and a copy button.

items.name: code-result-block
items.title: Code result block
items.description: Code beside what it makes. Each tab is one small change; switching marks the changed lines and fades the result to its new state. Real text with a copy button.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single disclosure for optional detail.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: Pick a colour from swatches or a free spectrum, with a contrast readout.

items.name: combo-chart
items.title: Combo chart
items.description: An amount as bars and a rate as a line, on two axes. The bars rise first and the line draws over them; one column highlight reads both.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select with grouped options and keywords.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: A searchable list of destinations and actions opened from the keyboard.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment thread
items.description: Comments and replies with a composer.

items.name: comparison-block
items.title: Comparison block
items.description: The switch, row by row: the same task the old way and with your product, side by side.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: A feature grid comparing plans or products row by row.

items.name: composition-chart
items.title: Composition chart
items.description: Parts of a whole with a comparison to the previous period.

items.name: condensing-header
items.title: Condensing header
items.description: A page header that makes room as you read: the title shrinks into a bar, the description folds away and a border appears, following the scroll.

items.name: confirm-morph
items.title: Confirm morph
items.description: A destructive action that morphs into its own confirmation, with undo.

items.name: connection-banner
items.title: Connection banner
items.description: Says when the app lost its connection and what that means, counts down to the next try, and confirms when it is back.

items.name: contact-section
items.title: Contact section
items.description: A contact form beside the ways to reach a team.

items.name: contact-template
items.title: Contact template
items.description: A contact page that routes the message first: pick the topic and it says who answers and how soon. The form keeps what you typed if sending fails and confirms where the reply will go.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: A menu opened with a right-click or long press on a piece of content.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: Asks once and plainly: reject and accept carry the same weight, choices explain what they are for, and the preferences can be reopened later.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value and confirms what was copied, with a fallback when the clipboard is blocked.

items.name: count-badge
items.title: Count badge
items.description: A count on an icon or tab that rolls up or down to its new number, pops once when something new arrives and shrinks away at zero.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: A live countdown to a date, in a large or compact style.

items.name: cta-block
items.title: CTA block
items.description: The closing call to action: the promise again, one specific next step and a reassurance line.

items.name: cursor-label
items.title: Cursor label
items.description: A small pill follows the pointer over a labelled area and says what a click does there: Drag, Play, Open. On touch it becomes a label in the corner.

items.name: cylinder-carousel
items.title: Cylinder carousel
items.description: Items arranged around a rotating cylinder.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Accessible table markup with consistent cell styling and a scrollable region.

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date input
items.description: A date field you type into, with the reading shown live and a month that carries data marks.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date field that opens a calendar, with min, max and today shortcuts.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: Choose a start and end date with preset ranges.

items.name: depth-timeline
items.title: Depth timeline
items.description: Time as distance. The current row is near and sharp, what comes later recedes along the road, and what has shipped slips behind you. Distance follows certainty too: far rows are labelled Planned or Exploring, and every date and status is written out.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description list
items.description: A record's details as label and value pairs, side by side when there is room, with copy and edit where the value sits.

items.name: device-frame
items.title: Device frame
items.description: Show live UI inside a laptop or a phone. The lid opens and the whole device turns, but the screen is an ordinary subtree laid out at the device's true width (1280 or 390 pixels) inside a size container, so breakpoints and container queries behave exactly as in the product.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window that asks for a decision or a short form, with focus kept inside.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets reading direction for everything inside it. Spacing, borders, affixes and the selected edge follow on their own; icons that point somewhere flip when marked.

items.name: direction-sphere
items.title: Direction sphere
items.description: A direction input shaped like what it controls. Drag a light across a sphere and a sample beside it takes the highlight and drop shadow of that light. Two sliders carry the same two numbers, so the sphere is a convenience and never the only way in.

items.name: diverging-bar-chart
items.title: Diverging bar chart
items.description: Agree–disagree answers centred on neutral, so questions compare by sentiment. Segments grow outward from the centre line.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A floating dock of icon destinations with a gliding active pill.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Parts of a whole as a ring, with the total in the centre.

items.name: draw-on
items.title: Draw on
items.description: Wraps an inline SVG so its strokes draw themselves in, one after another, when it scrolls into view. Nodes can fade in after their line arrives.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from the left or right for editing alongside the page.

items.name: drill-down-menu
items.title: Drill down menu
items.description: A menu that goes deeper one level at a time: the next level slides in, Back slides it out, and the height eases to fit.

items.name: drop-overlay
items.title: Drop overlay
items.description: Lets a whole area take dropped files: a clear target rises over the content while files are dragged in and names what will happen.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions anchored to a trigger, with groups, shortcuts and separators.

items.name: dumbbell-chart
items.title: Dumbbell chart
items.description: A before and an after per row joined by a bar. The after dot travels out from the before value, and sorting by change moves rows to their new places.

items.name: duration-field
items.title: Duration field
items.description: A length of time, not a time of day: type it the way you would say it (90, 1h 30m, 1:30), step it with the buttons or arrow keys, or pick a common length.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic island
items.description: A compact pill that grows to show one live activity, then collapses.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A message with an icon and a next step for when there is nothing to show.

items.name: error-template
items.title: Error template
items.description: The pages people land on when something goes wrong, each with the way out that fits: search, ask for access, retry with a reference, wait out maintenance, reconnect or get a new link.

items.name: expandable-action-bar
items.title: Expandable action bar
items.description: A compact bar of actions that expands to reveal labels.

items.name: expandable-card
items.title: Expandable card
items.description: A card that grows in place to reveal its details.

items.name: expanding-button-group
items.title: Expanding button group
items.description: A row of icon buttons where the focused one expands to show its label.

items.name: expanding-search
items.title: Expanding search
items.description: A search that expands from an icon into a results list.

items.name: exploded-view
items.title: Exploded view
items.description: Pull a composed interface apart along its depth axis so each layer can be named. Spread is one continuous value: at 0 it is the finished interface seen face on, at 1 it is the labelled stack. The list carries every name, and hovering or focusing a row lights its plane and dims the rest.

items.name: faq-block
items.title: FAQ block
items.description: Searchable questions with one answer open at a time, each linking to the exact doc, and a way to ask when nothing matches.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ section
items.description: Questions that open to reveal answers.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature bento
items.description: A bento grid of features of different sizes.

items.name: feature-rows-block
items.title: Feature rows block
items.description: Features as numbered rows, each with a product fragment or one figure that proves it.

items.name: feature-tabs-block
items.title: Feature tabs block
items.description: A short feature tour: features beside one stage, with a thin rule that fills and moves on. It waits while hovered, focused or off screen; choosing a feature or Pause stops it.

items.name: feed-stream
items.title: Feed stream
items.description: A live feed that keeps your place: at the top new items slide in; scrolled away, a pill counts what is waiting and takes you back up.

items.name: feedback-widget
items.title: Feedback widget
items.description: A small widget to rate and comment from any page.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wraps a control with its label, hint, error and optional action, wired for assistive tech.

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File diff
items.description: A line-by-line comparison of two versions of a file.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File dropzone
items.description: Drop or choose files, with per-file progress, errors and cancel.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: A keyboard-navigable tree for folders and files.

items.name: filter-toolbar
items.title: Filter toolbar
items.description: A search field and filter menus with result counts, for narrowing a list.

items.name: fixtures
items.title: Fixtures
items.description: A list of matches or events grouped by date, with scores.

items.name: floating-button-group
items.title: Floating button group
items.description: A toolbar of icon and label buttons with separators and pressed states.

items.name: fold-panel
items.title: Fold panel
items.description: An accordion whose sections are hinged to their headers. Opening turns a section down from edge-on to flat while its height opens, so you can see which header it belongs to and where it goes when it closes. It is the standard accordion underneath: header buttons, aria-expanded, regions named by their header.

items.name: folder-tabs
items.title: Folder tabs
items.description: Tabs as folders in a drawer. The chosen folder comes to the front and the rest sit behind it with their tabs showing, so you can see how many there are and where you are. Distance back is the number of steps from the open tab.

items.name: footer-block
items.title: Footer block
items.description: The page's last word: link columns, a newsletter that confirms in place, the legal line, status and the name as a full-width wordmark.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: Stages of a process narrowing as people drop out.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A dial for one value in a range, with named thresholds.

items.name: heatmap-matrix
items.title: Heatmap matrix
items.description: Two categories against each other, coloured by value. The row and column follow the pointer or arrow keys, and choosing a step of the scale isolates its cells.

items.name: hero-block
items.title: Hero block
items.description: The first screen of a product page: one claim, two actions and a real artefact that proves it.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero section
items.description: The top of a landing page: eyebrow, title, copy, actions and proof.

items.name: hero-signup
items.title: Hero signup
items.description: A hero with a sign-up form built in.

items.name: hinge-panel
items.title: Hinge panel
items.description: A list with a detail panel hinged to its edge. Choosing a row swings the panel open toward you from where the list ends, so the detail visibly belongs to the row you chose, and closing swings it back onto the list. The panel itself is flat, readable content.

items.name: histogram
items.title: Histogram
items.description: The shape of a distribution. Choosing coarser or finer bins retargets the same bars, and the median and p95 markers slide to their values.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Hold to confirm, part of the Actions family.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview card that appears when hovering or focusing a link or name.

items.name: icon-swap
items.title: Icon swap
items.description: Turns one icon into another in place for a control whose meaning flips: copy to copied, play to pause, menu to close.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image compare
items.description: Two images stacked with a draggable divider.

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image generation
items.description: A card that shows an image as it is generated, from queued to complete.

items.name: image-viewer
items.title: Image viewer
items.description: A full-size viewer with zoom and keyboard navigation.

items.name: infinite-masonry
items.title: Infinite masonry
items.description: A masonry grid that loads more as you scroll.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Text that becomes editable in place, with a pencil as the hint.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A recessed text field with optional leading and trailing affixes; it never jumps when validation appears.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A generic row: media, title, description, meta and an action. It uses the data table's row spacing and its hover and selected fills.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JSON viewer
items.description: A collapsible tree of JSON with copy and search.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keys as small raised caps: one shortcut per kbd, ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere, with spoken names for symbols.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name for a field, tied to it so a click focuses the control.

items.name: landing-template
items.title: Landing template
items.description: A whole product page from the Free blocks, in the order buyers decide, with a header that keeps the action in reach.

items.name: layer-parallax
items.title: Layer parallax
items.description: A composition of layers that shift against each other as the mouse moves, each by its own depth, with the whole scene tilting no more than 5 degrees. It explains how a screen is built: the grid behind, the card on it, the chip and the toast in front. It is for docs and demonstration stages, never for controls or moving text.

items.name: legal-template
items.title: Legal template
items.description: A policy people can read: the short version first, numbered sections with an outline that follows you, linkable clauses, a change history and a print layout.

items.name: lift-list
items.title: Lift list
items.description: A list you reorder by picking a row up. The row you hold comes off the page, rises toward you and leans a few degrees the way you move, and a dashed slot shows where it will land. Space picks up, the arrows move, Space drops, Escape puts it back.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: One or more series over time, with hover readout and an optional band.

items.name: liquidity-heatmap
items.title: Liquidity heatmap
items.description: Resting size by price and time as a heatmap with an optional mid line.

items.name: live-indicator
items.title: Live indicator
items.description: Whether a feed is live, in words and a dot. The dot sends out a soft ring only while live, blinks while reconnecting and rests otherwise, and gives one extra ring for each update you tell it about.

items.name: live-pass
items.title: Live pass
items.description: A credential card with a foil you check by tilting it. A sheen follows the mouse and a VERIFIED mark only shows once the card is tilted far enough, as security foil does on a banknote. A screenshot cannot show it, and the line beneath keeps a ticking clock, so a still image of the pass is obviously stale.

items.name: load-more
items.title: Load more
items.description: The end of a long list: the next page loads as it comes into view, failures offer a retry, a button does the same for keyboards, and the end says so.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: A small indeterminate indicator in four shapes.

items.name: loading-swap
items.title: Loading swap
items.description: Swaps a loading placeholder for its content without a jump: the content fades in while the height eases once.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo marquee
items.description: Customer logos in a slow scrolling row.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Wraps one button or link so it leans toward the pointer as it comes near, up to 8px, and settles back when the pointer leaves.

items.name: marketing-sections
items.title: Marketing sections
items.description: Hero, feature and pricing sections for a landing page.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A slow scrolling row of content that pauses on hover.

items.name: mention-input
items.title: Mention input
items.description: A text field that turns @people and #channels into mentions.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: File, Edit and View for an app that works like a desktop program: one highlight glides along the bar, and once a menu is open, moving along opens the next.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One chat message with a role, optional name, status and actions.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: A scrolling transcript that stays pinned to the newest message.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, with thresholds marked on the track and a word for whether it is fine.

items.name: metric
items.title: Metric
items.description: A number with its context, change and a small trend line.

items.name: milestones-block
items.title: Milestones block
items.description: A history read top to bottom. One line fills as the list scrolls through the window and each marker settles when it is reached, using native scroll only.

items.name: money-field
items.title: Money field
items.description: A currency amount field with a currency picker and quick-add steps.

items.name: morph-surface
items.title: Morph surface
items.description: A floating surface that grows out of the element that opened it.

items.name: morphing-modal
items.title: Morphing modal
items.description: A modal whose surface morphs between views, like a menu becoming a confirmation.

items.name: multi-chain-swap
items.title: Multi chain swap
items.description: Swap one asset for another across networks, with a quote.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi select
items.description: Choose several values from a list, shown as a compact summary.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A site header whose items open frosted panels of links. Hover waits for intent, the panel resizes from one item to the next, and every link is reachable by keyboard.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: An email field with consent and success states.

items.name: not-found-page
items.title: Not found page
items.description: A friendly 404 with suggestions and search.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification bell
items.description: The bell that opens notifications: the unread count sits on it and rolls to its new value, the bell swings once when the count rises, and its name always says how many are unread.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification center
items.description: A list of notifications with read state and filters.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification stack
items.description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover or focus.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A numeric field with steppers, limits, a suffix and optional drag-to-scrub.

items.name: number-tween
items.title: Number tween
items.description: A number that eases to its new value instead of jumping.

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order book
items.description: Bids and asks as depth bars around the spread.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: A segmented field for one-time codes with paste support and status.

items.name: overflow-actions
items.title: Overflow actions
items.description: A few primary actions with the rest tucked behind an expander.

items.name: page-dots
items.title: Page dots
items.description: Where you are in a set of slides: the current dot stretches into a pill that fills while slides advance on their own.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: A title with description, breadcrumbs and actions.

items.name: page-parts
items.title: Page parts
items.description: Dashboard, password reset and verification screens.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with previous and next, sized for touch.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: A password input with a show and hide control.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password strength
items.description: A new-password field that shows a strength meter and the rules it meets.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: Phone field
items.description: A phone number field with a country picker, formatting and validity.

items.name: pinned-list
items.title: Pinned list
items.description: Items you can pin to the top. Pinning moves the row up into Pinned and back again, so the eye follows it, and focus stays on the same pin button.

items.name: plan-comparison
items.title: Plan comparison
items.description: Plans side by side with prices and feature lists.

items.name: polar-area-chart
items.title: Polar area chart
items.description: Equal wedges whose length shows the value, for categories with an order around a circle such as months, hours or directions. Wedges grow out from the centre.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel anchored to a trigger for quick settings or details.

items.name: prediction-market
items.title: Prediction market
items.description: Outcomes with probabilities and a way to take a position.

items.name: presence-list
items.title: Presence list
items.description: A list where an added row opens from nothing and a removed row closes, so a live feed or a queue changes without jumping. The first render is immediate.

items.name: preview-rail
items.title: Preview rail
items.description: A rail of ticks that previews each section on hover and jumps to it.

items.name: price-target-fan
items.title: Price target fan
items.description: A price history that fans out into a forecast range.

items.name: pricing-block
items.title: Pricing block
items.description: Pricing worked out from the buyer's own numbers: enter seats and each plan shows its total and why it fits.

items.name: pricing-template
items.title: Pricing template
items.description: A pricing page in one voice: the deal in one line, plans worked out from the buyer's numbers, the switch row by row, the last doubts and one action.

items.name: profile-page
items.title: Profile page
items.description: A person's page: who they are and where, their local time, pinned work, a year of activity and what they did lately. Following updates at once and rolls back if it fails.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A measured bar for work with a known size, such as an upload.

items.name: progress-button
items.title: Progress button
items.description: A button that fills with determinate progress while its work runs, writes the percentage, and settles on a check.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: Progress ring
items.description: Determinate progress in a ring that eases to each value, draws a check when done and a cross when it fails.

items.name: project-folder
items.title: Project folder
items.description: A folder card that opens to show its contents.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: A message box with attachments, suggestions, commands and a stop button.

items.name: proof-block
items.title: Proof block
items.description: Logos set as type, a case study led by one number, press with outlet and date, and live figures with their source.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Spacing, a readable measure and quiet links for long-form markup you do not control, such as a Markdown render, release notes or a legal page.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to refresh
items.description: Pull a list down to refresh it, with a button for everyone else.

items.name: radial-bar-chart
items.title: Radial bar chart
items.description: Four to seven categories as concentric arcs that fill toward the largest one. Sorting moves each arc to its new ring.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A native radio for choosing exactly one option from a short group.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio cards
items.description: Large selectable cards for a choice that needs a title and a description.

items.name: range-histogram
items.title: Range histogram
items.description: A range filter over the shape of the data: bars outside the range dim as you drag, and the count in range is written out.

items.name: range-slider
items.title: Range slider
items.description: A two-handle slider for choosing a range of values.

items.name: rank-list
items.title: Rank list
items.description: A leaderboard that re-ranks as values change: rows travel to their new place, values count to their new figure, and a mark says how many places each row moved.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Stars that are a native radio group: arrows change the value, a pointer previews, half steps when you need them, and a read-only average that says how many ratings it comes from.

items.name: reaction-bar
items.title: Reaction bar
items.description: Emoji reactions under a message or post. Each chip is a toggle; the count rolls and your chip settles with one small pop. The picker adds a new reaction.

items.name: read-more
items.title: Read more
items.description: Long text kept to a few lines until asked for: it opens to its full height, closes to a faded edge, and the button appears only when needed.

items.name: reading-progress
items.title: Reading progress
items.description: Where you are in a long page, in a small pill that appears once you start scrolling: a ring that fills as you read, the section you are in and how far through you are. Press it to jump to another section.

items.name: resizable-panels
items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: Two panels separated by a draggable, keyboard-operable divider.

items.name: result-icon
items.title: Result icon
items.description: The outcome of an operation as a mark that draws itself once: a check, a cross, an exclamation, or a turning arc only while pending.

items.name: returns-calendar
items.title: Returns calendar
items.description: A month calendar coloured by daily return, with a compounded total.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: A small editor with bold, italic, lists and links, returning HTML.

items.name: ridgeline
items.title: Ridgeline
items.description: Stacked distributions that overlap for easy comparison.

items.name: roadmap-block
items.title: Roadmap block
items.description: A public roadmap in now, next and later. Votes roll the count and move the card to its place in the column, so readers see their vote count.

items.name: rotary-knob
items.title: Rotary knob
items.description: A rotary control with a real edge. The knob is a short cylinder seen from above: a stack of discs gives it thickness, a ring of ticks lights up to the value, and the number is always written beside it. Drag it or use the keys; with detents on it clicks through every tenth.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter chart
items.description: Two measures per item, with an optional third as point size. Points grow in, hidden groups shrink away, and a trend line with its fit draws after them.

items.name: scene-story-block
items.title: Scene story block
items.description: A chapter section told by scrolling, with a 3D scene beside it. As you read, the scene tips toward you and its layers spread apart, and the layer the chapter is about lights while the others dim. The chapters are complete without the scene.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A labelled, keyboard-focusable scroll region with a quiet scrollbar.

items.name: scroll-aware-fab
items.title: Scroll aware fab
items.description: The main action kept in reach: it shows its label at the top and when scrolling up, and shrinks to its icon while you scroll down.

items.name: scroll-effects
items.title: Scroll effects
items.description: Tools for effects that follow scroll position, such as progress and reveals.

items.name: scroll-shadow
items.title: Scroll shadow
items.description: A scroll area whose edges fade only where there is more to see, easing in and out as you reach either end.

items.name: scroll-spy-nav
items.title: Scroll spy nav
items.description: An outline that follows your reading: a marker glides to the section in view, and choosing a link scrolls there and moves focus into it.

items.name: scroll-story
items.title: Scroll story
items.description: Sections that change as you scroll.

items.name: scroll-timeline
items.title: Scroll timeline
items.description: A history down the page: the line fills as you scroll and each entry lights and settles as the line reaches it.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: A search field with a clear button and the right keyboard on phones.

items.name: secret-field
items.title: Secret field
items.description: A secret shown only on purpose: reveal it and the characters settle into place, and it masks itself again on a visible timer. Copying never needs it revealed.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Segmented control, part of the Blocks family.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A styled native select for choosing one option from a short list.

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select menu
items.description: A select whose list opens with the chosen option over the trigger; the platform picker on touch.

items.name: selection-toolbar
items.title: Selection toolbar
items.description: Actions for the words you selected, where you selected them: the toolbar grows out of the selection and leaves with it; Alt+T reaches it from the keyboard.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1px divider in the toolbar's own hairline, with a labelled form for “or continue with email”. Decoration unless you say otherwise.

items.name: session-timeout
items.title: Session timeout
items.description: A fair warning before a session ends: a dialog counts down with a ring, offers to stay signed in, and signs out at zero.

items.name: shader-background
items.title: Shader background
items.description: A GPU-drawn animated background.

items.name: shake
items.title: Shake
items.description: Nudges a field or control sideways once to say “not accepted”, with an outline instead under reduced motion.

items.name: shared-highlight
items.title: Shared highlight
items.description: A highlight that glides between the items of a list as focus or hover moves.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut recorder
items.description: Press a key combination to record a keyboard shortcut, with conflict warnings.

items.name: shortcut-sheet
items.title: Shortcut sheet
items.description: Every keyboard shortcut in one place: while it is open, pressing a shortcut lights its row instead of running it, and a filter narrows the list.

items.name: showcase-block
items.title: Showcase block
items.description: The product one job at a time: tabs beside a single stage, each view swapped in place with one line on what it does.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible navigation rail for an app's main sections.

items.name: sign-in-form
items.title: Sign in form
items.description: An email and password form with provider buttons and clear errors.

items.name: sign-up-form
items.title: Sign up form
items.description: An account-creation form with a password strength hint and terms.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature pad
items.description: Draw a signature with a pointer or finger, with undo and clear.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Link columns, social links and legal text.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: A top navigation bar with logo, links and actions.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder with the shape of the content it stands in for.

items.name: skyline-chart
items.title: Skyline chart
items.description: A day-by-time grid whose cells rise into columns. Seen from straight above it is an exact heatmap, and colour repeats every height so nothing is lost when it is flat. Tilt it up to see the shape of the week. The busiest cell is the one ember column.

items.name: slide-panels
items.title: Slide panels
items.description: Steps that move like pages: forward slides in from the right, back from the left, the height eases, and focus arrives with the new panel.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to confirm
items.description: A deliberate commit: drag the handle to the end, or use the arrow keys, and it confirms; let go early and it springs back.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A native range input styled to match, with accessible value text.

items.name: slope-chart
items.title: Slope chart
items.description: Items connected between two moments to show who rose and who fell.

items.name: slot-text
items.title: Slot text
items.description: Text whose characters roll like a slot machine when the value changes.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable list
items.description: A list reordered by dragging or with keyboard commands, with undo.

items.name: sortable-table
items.title: Sortable table
items.description: A table with sortable columns, optional selection, loading and empty states.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny trend line with no axes, for use inside text and tables.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: A primary action joined to its alternatives; the chosen option becomes the label.

items.name: spotlight-grid
items.title: Spotlight grid
items.description: A grid where a spotlight follows the pointer.

items.name: stacked-area-chart
items.title: Stacked area chart
items.description: Parts of a whole over time, stacked from the baseline. Switching between values and share morphs the same layers, so growth and share read as one picture.

items.name: stagger
items.title: Stagger
items.description: Children of a group arrive one after another on mount or when scrolled into view, so a new list reads in order.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: A bordered figure with a label, description and change.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats band
items.description: A row of big numbers with short labels.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status bar
items.description: A row of period blocks coloured by service status.

items.name: status-morph
items.title: Status morph
items.description: A status that changes in place: the pill eases to its new width while icon and colour cross over, and the change is announced.

items.name: step-loader
items.title: Step loader
items.description: What a long operation is doing: done steps tick off, the current one turns with its detail, the line fills, and a failure says where and why.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Shows where someone is in a multi-step flow and lets them go back.

items.name: steps-block
items.title: Steps block
items.description: How it works, step by step, with an honest time and what exists after each step.

items.name: streamgraph
items.title: Streamgraph
items.description: Stacked series that flow around a centre line.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming response
items.description: Markdown-like text that renders cleanly while it is still arriving.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: Row actions revealed by swiping, with a keyboard route to the same actions.

items.name: swipe-tabs
items.title: Swipe tabs
items.description: Tabs for touch: swipe the content and the next panel follows the finger while the indicator slides in step.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch, part of the Inputs family.

items.name: sync-status
items.title: Sync status
items.description: Whether the work on screen is safe, in one pill that changes in place: saving, saved, offline with changes waiting, failed with a retry, or edited elsewhere.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related views of the same content without leaving the page.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Type and press Enter or comma to turn text into removable tags.

items.name: team-block
items.title: Team block
items.description: People introduced by what they own and how to reach them, with initials when there is no photo.

items.name: testimonials-block
items.title: Testimonials block
items.description: Customer quotes that carry a real role and a measurable outcome, set still and readable.

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text loop
items.description: One word in a sentence that cycles through a few options. The widest word reserves the space, it pauses on hover, focus, off screen and in a hidden tab, and a pause button stops it.

items.name: text-motion
items.title: Text motion
items.description: Text reveals, morphs and shimmer.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A recessed multi-line field that grows with the draft from 3 to 8 lines.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: A light and dark toggle that changes at once or reveals the new theme with a circle, seam or wipe.

items.name: thread-composer
items.title: Thread composer
items.description: A compact reply box for comments and threads, with send and cancel built in.

items.name: ticket-stub
items.title: Ticket stub
items.description: A ticket with a perforated stub. Checking in tears the stub off along the perforation, so used is something you can see on the ticket and not only read. The tear is the feedback; the plain text line on the ticket is the record.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt card
items.description: A card that tilts toward the pointer with a soft highlight.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: Choose a time with minute steps and a 12 or 24 hour format.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events in order with dates and markers.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short, dismissible message that confirms an action, with an optional undo.

items.name: todo-list
items.title: Todo list
items.description: A checklist an agent or user ticks through, with progress.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle and toggle group
items.description: A button that stays pressed, alone or in a raised group that holds one choice or many and moves with the arrow keys as a single tab stop.

items.name: tool-result
items.title: Tool result
items.description: The outcome of a tool call, collapsed to a summary and expandable to detail.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Tools with one tab stop: arrows move between them, toggles sit recessed, and when the row runs out of width the last tools fold into a More menu with their state.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint that appears on hover or focus, never the only way to learn something.

items.name: transcript-reel
items.title: Transcript reel
items.description: A transcript on a curved surface. The line being read is large and faces you; the lines before and after bend away along a cylinder, so you keep your place while it plays. Every line shows its time and speaker, and clicking one seeks to it.

items.name: transfer-list
items.title: Transfer list
items.description: Choose a subset from a long list: tick items and move them across, and they slide into the other side from where they came.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: An expandable hierarchy with selection and meta text.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Nested rectangles sized by value, with drill-down.

items.name: trend-delta
items.title: Trend delta
items.description: A change as a chip: the arrow turns to the direction, the number counts to its value, and colour and words say whether it is good.

items.name: upload-queue
items.title: Upload queue
items.description: Files on their way up, each with its own progress ring; failures say why with a retry, and rows open and close without the list jumping.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: A segmented bar showing how an allowance is used, with a warning near the limit.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User menu
items.description: A dropdown for the signed-in person's identity and account actions.

items.name: view-transition
items.title: View transition
items.description: Moves between views without a cut: the old view fades or slides out as the new one comes in, with the View Transition API where available.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: An animated orb that shows idle, listening, thinking and speaking states.

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume profile
items.description: Traded volume by price level, with the value area and last price marked.

items.name: vote-control
items.title: Vote control
items.description: Up and down votes with a rolling score. Choosing the same arrow again clears your vote; the owner saves it optimistically and can revert.

items.name: waffle-chart
items.title: Waffle chart
items.description: Parts of a whole as a grid of squares you can count.

items.name: wallet-card
items.title: Wallet card
items.description: A payment card with brand, last four digits and actions.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel picker
items.description: A scrolling wheel for choosing one value, with keyboard and wheel support.

items.name: working-border
items.title: Working border
items.description: A surface whose edge carries a moving light only while real work is pending, such as an agent run or an import. When the work ends the light stops.

items.name: zoom-lens
items.title: Zoom lens
items.description: A magnifier that follows the pointer, a finger or the arrow keys over an image to show detail.
